item.title: NOTICE OF REOPENING OF PUBLIC COMMENT PERIOD ON PROPOSED RULES
item.description:
Board of Correction | Agency Rules | Notice

Notice of Reopening of Public Comment Period on Proposed Rules

 

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Board of Correction is reopening the public comment period for the proposed rules concerning amendments to the Boards Minimum Standards related to mental health and health care. These rule proposals were first published in the City Record on January 12, 2026.
